verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents pieces of this story: it imports actuals from QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite and Rillet, builds forecasts, and its Model supports Dimensions. Ari can explain 'why spending went up', and outputs print lineage back to the source line, which approximates drill-down into the transactions behind a number. However, no evidence describes a budget-vs-actuals report, a variance view split by department and account, or transaction-level drill-down from a variance. Missing for 10: an explicit budget-vs-actuals feature, a department/account variance breakdown, documented transaction drill-down from a variance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
